device.type: DVB-S2 Full HD compact satellite receiver
device.soc: ALi C3503C (chip word 0x3503C000, SDK chip code 0x10050, OTP product 5)

simulator.note: Boots as the single-CPU C3503 family (chips/c3503.py, chip word 0x3503C000 -> SDK chip code 0x10050, run_dump_a53_v133b6_patch_app_starts.py, run_dump_a53_v133b6_patch_capture_screen.py): its boot-ROM bootloader inherits $sp = 0x9FE07F00 from the boot ROM, calibrates DDR delay from the ring-oscillator count in the upper half of 0xB8000300 ("RingOSDelay=296.29600(ns)"), prints "CRC Check Result : Pass", and unpacks the 9.85 MB maincode (0x9d87cc bytes) to 0x80000200.  The internal DVB-S2 demodulator answers at 0xB804C000 and the M3031 tuner at I2C 0x20 ("M3031" on UART).  Renders its 1280x720 "System Setup" OSD menu through GMA layer 0 at 0xB8006300.

desc: Ferguson Ariva 53 patched firmware V1.33B6_PATCH (2019-03-15) for the compact Full HD DVB-S2 satellite receiver on the single-CPU ALi C3503C SoC.
